title: Ashby Jobs Search
description: Type a job title and press Start: you get the newest matching jobs from every company on Ashby (3,478 hiring companies, 61,000+ open jobs). Every other field is optional. Press Start with the form empty for the newest jobs of every kind.

searchTerms.title: Job titles to find (searchTerms)
searchTerms.description: Type the job titles or keywords to find, one per line, for example software engineer. A job matches when its title has every word of a line: frontend also finds Front-End. Leave it empty to get the newest jobs of every kind. A pasted Google dork or Ashby link works too.

location.title: Where the job is (location)
location.description: Type where the jobs should be: a city, state, country or region, one per line, for example London, United States, EMEA or LatAm. US, USA and United States all work; a region finds its countries and the jobs posted for it. Worldwide finds the jobs open everywhere. Type Remote here to get remote jobs. Leave it empty for anywhere.

workType.title: Remote or onsite (workType)
workType.description: Pick remote, hybrid or onsite, or several. Leave it empty for all of them. Typed words such as wfh or office work too.

postedWithin.title: Posted in the last (postedWithin)
postedWithin.description: Pick how new the jobs must be: posted in the last 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days. Any time, the default, keeps every open job, newest first. You can also type your own period, such as 48 hours or 2 weeks.

maxJobs.title: Number of jobs (maxJobs)
maxJobs.description: Type how many jobs to get, newest first: 100 by default. Type 0 to get every matching job. Each job is one charged row, so this also sets the most a run can cost.

includeDetails.title: Full details (includeDetails)
includeDetails.description: Tick to add the full details of each job: the description, the salary numbers (lowest, highest, currency, per year or hour), equity, and the city, region and country. A job with details costs $1.35 per 1,000 instead of $1.20.

excludeTerms.title: Leave out words (excludeTerms)
excludeTerms.description: Type words that leave a job out when its title has them, one per line, for example senior or manager. Leave it empty to keep every job.

employmentType.title: Job type (employmentType)
employmentType.description: Pick the job type: full-time, part-time, contract, internship or temporary, or several. Leave it empty for every job type. Typed words such as freelance or temp work too.

searchDescriptions.title: Match descriptions (searchDescriptions)
searchDescriptions.description: Tick to match your keywords in the job description too, not only in the title: python then finds every job that asks for Python. A run takes about two minutes longer.

companies.title: Only these companies (companies)
companies.description: Type companies to search only them, one per line: a name (OpenAI), a board name (openai) or a board link (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/openai). Leave it empty to search every company on Ashby. A few companies take seconds.

jobUrls.title: Job links to check (jobUrls)
jobUrls.description: Paste Ashby job links, one per line, to check whether they are still open instead of searching. Each link comes back open (with the job), closed, or not found. Handy for cleaning dead links out of a job board or a sheet.
